parties: Electric City Corp., a Delaware corporation
renewal_terms: Renewable annually for up to an additional ten (10) years on the same terms and conditions (Section 1.3)
key_obligations: Distributor must issue an irrevocable Letter of Credit in the amount of $500,000 at the commencement of the Term (Section 2.4(a))
Distributor must receive a minimum purchase order of $250,000 by the first of each month for a 12-month period
Distributor must commit to 375 units in the first Product Year (1999)
Company appoints Distributor as exclusive distributor within the State of Illinois (Section 1.1)
Initial term is ten (10) years commencing upon delivery of the last Sample by Company to Distributor
Renewal is annual for up to an additional ten (10) years on the same terms and conditions (Section 1.3)
Distributor must submit written reports to Company each quarter during the first year of the Term, commencing 90 days after execution (Section 4.1)

risk_flags.issue: Automatic renewal trap: Agreement renews for up to ten additional years without a specified right of first refusal or termination notice period
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Add a requirement that Distributor must provide written notice at least 90 days prior to each annual renewal date to exercise the option to renew

risk_flags.issue: Broad indemnification scope: Requires Distributor to indemnify Company for unauthorized Product alteration even if Company is not at fault
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Limit indemnification to cases where Distributor is at fault or negligent

risk_flags.issue: Short cure period: Either party may terminate upon 30 days' notice for default, which may be insufficient for complex breaches
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Extend the cure period to allow sufficient time to remedy complex breaches

risk_flags.issue: Repurchase Obligation: Company has sole discretion to repurchase Products from Distributor at net invoice price less allowances, leaving Distributor with unsold inventory risk
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Negotiate a guaranteed buyback provision or clearer repurchase terms

recommendation: The agreement contains significant risks including an automatic renewal trap with no specified termination notice period, broad indemnification obligations that may expose the Distributor to liability for unauthorized product alterations even without fault, and a short 30-day cure period for termination. The Distributor should negotiate explicit renewal notice requirements, limit indemnification scope to fault-based claims, and extend the cure period. Additionally, the lack of a guaranteed repurchase obligation leaves the Distributor with inventory risk upon termination.
